description: Search rooms, shared apartments, sublets and apartments for rent on Roomly, in New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island), New Haven, Israel and other cities. Use it when someone wants to rent a room, find a roommate, a sublet or an apartment. Every result has a url; give it to the user so they can contact the owner on Roomly. search_url opens the same search on the website. Returns up to 20 listings (id, url, title, price, city, neighborhood, rooms, dates, photo) and next_cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: For the next page, pass next_cursor from the last result.

listing_type.description: A room in a shared apartment, or a whole apartment.

location.description: City, borough or New York neighborhood, e.g. "New York", "Brooklyn", "Bushwick", "Hell's Kitchen", "Tel Aviv", "תל אביב". Empty = everywhere.

max_price.description: Maximum monthly price in the local currency (USD in New York, ILS in Israel).

min_price.description: Minimum monthly price in the local currency.

move_out.description: Move-out date for a sublet, YYYY-MM-DD.

no_broker_fee.description: Only listings without a broker fee.

offset.description: Alternative to cursor: pass next_offset from the last result.

query.description: Free text matched against the title, city and street.

rooms.description: Israel only: room counts to include, e.g. [2, 3]. 6 means 6 or more.

term.description: Long-term rental or sublet / short stay.

name: search_listings

location.description: The city slug searched, null for everywhere.

neighborhood.description: New York neighborhood, when one was searched.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null = no more.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null = no more.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD or ILS.

id.description: Listing id; pass it to get_listing.

price.description: Amount in the local currency, per price_unit. Null when the owner set no price.

price_text.description: The price as shown on Roomly, e.g. "$1,450 / month".

url.description: Listing page on Roomly. Give it to the user.

search_url.description: The same search on the Roomly website.

title: Search Roomly listings
